title: Blackstone to open Kuwait office in Q3 2026
summary: The US alternative asset manager is also considering a second UAE office at the Dubai International Financial Centre, Reuters reported
thbAction: Map the news to THB's provider CRM for referral growth, patient lifecycle engagement, and multi-facility relationship management across hospital and provider networks.
contentHtml:
The US alternative asset manager is also considering a second UAE office at the Dubai International Financial Centre, Reuters reported

Staff Writer ,  ZAWYA

US alternative asset manager Blackstone is setting up an office in Kuwait through the Kuwait Direct Investment Promotion Authority (KDIPA) as part of a wider GCC expansion drive.
